ddl.value: ("project_id" IS NULL AND "target" LIKE 'location:%') OR ("project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "target" NOT LIKE 'location:%')
ddl.name: ck_grant_owner

ddl.value: ("project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_root" IS NULL AND "slug" IS NULL) OR ("project_id" IS NULL AND "workspace_root" IS NOT NULL AND "slug" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: ck_backup_owner

ddl.value: ("type" IN ('workspace.changed', 'workspace.lease_lost', 'workspace.reattached', 'runtime.preparing', 'runtime.ready') AND "project_id" IS NULL) OR ("type" IN ('file.changed', 'project.changed', 'job.progress', 'job.done') AND "project_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: ck_event_project_shape

ddl.value: substr("secret_hash", 1, 7) = 'sha256:' AND length("secret_hash") = 71 AND substr("secret_hash", 8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
ddl.name: ck_credential_secret_hash

ddl.value: ("capture_state" = 'pending' OR (("previous_content" IS NULL AND "previous_object_hash" IS NULL AND "captured_hash" IS NULL) OR (("previous_content" IS NOT NULL OR "previous_object_hash" IS NOT NULL) AND "captured_hash" IS "from_hash")))
ddl.name: ck_step_capture_shape

ddl.value: (("kind" = 'entity' AND "path" IS NULL AND "entity" IS NOT NULL AND "existed_before" IS NULL) OR ("kind" IN ('write', 'delete') AND "path" IS NOT NULL AND "entity" IS NULL AND "existed_before" IS NULL) OR ("kind" IN ('mkdir', 'rmdir') AND "path" IS NOT NULL AND "entity" IS NULL AND "from_hash" IS NULL AND "to_hash" IS NULL AND "existed_before" IS NOT NULL))
ddl.name: ck_step_shape

ddl.value:
(
    ("state" = 'mounted' AND "mounted_scene_id" IS NOT NULL AND "mounted_revision" IS NOT NULL
      AND "last_error_code" IS NULL AND "last_error_message" IS NULL)
    OR ("state" = 'uploaded_unmounted' AND "mounted_scene_id" IS NULL AND "mounted_revision" IS NULL)
    OR ("state" = 'abandoned' AND "mounted_scene_id" IS NULL AND "mounted_revision" IS NULL
      AND "last_error_code" IS NOT NULL AND "last_error_message" IS NOT NULL)
  )
ddl.name: ck_pending_mount_shape

ddl.value: (("kind" = 'entity' AND "path" IS NULL AND "entity" IS NOT NULL AND "existed_before" IS NULL) OR ("kind" IN ('write', 'delete') AND "path" IS NOT NULL AND "entity" IS NULL AND "existed_before" IS NULL) OR ("kind" IN ('mkdir', 'rmdir') AND "path" IS NOT NULL AND "entity" IS NULL AND "from_hash" IS NULL AND "to_hash" IS NULL AND "existed_before" IS NOT NULL))
ddl.name: ck_revision_step_shape
